decision_rule: all common and option-specific mandatory gates must be PASS with current hash-bound evidence; any other state or missing evidence blocks selection

common_mandatory_gates.requirement: authentication binds the exact ADR 0026 challenge bytes and domain separator
the exact complete unexpired ADR 0027 hash-only bundle is bound
every direct and transitive matrix cell is SEPARATE_WITH_EVIDENCE
two issuers have distinct identity, trust, authentication, recovery and host roots
no issuer administers or can recover the reviewed reviewer, verifier, result root or builders
caller nonce and issuer evidence IDs are atomically single-use with bounded time and monotonic epoch
authentication and recovery roots are separate and compromise recovery advances epoch without rollback
all issuer evidence parsers share bounded closed models and a negative differential corpus
audit retains digests and decisions without committing personnel, credential or operational artifact bytes
dependencies, licenses, advisories, monitoring and incident ownership are reviewed

threshold_dsse_offline_roots.requirement: 2-of-3 is enforced over three distinct active roots and duplicate signer identities cannot count twice
ordinary issuer signers cannot alone rotate roots, lower threshold or clear revocation
bounded DSSE parsing, exact payload type, canonical signatures and PAE preserve the issuer statement bytes
root creation, storage, activation, revocation and recovery ceremonies are independently witnessed

dual_webauthn_human_issuers.requirement: both issuers have separately witnessed roaming-authenticator enrollment with independent credential/recovery roots
both assertions use the exact consumer-allowlisted RP ID and origin with no fallback
both assertions require ES256, UP, UV, non-backup eligibility/state and exact challenge
issuer assignment, conflict disclosure and out-of-band review prevent one operator from satisfying both approvals

threshold_dsse_offline_roots: no roots, threshold ceremony, role policy, parser or recovery evidence exists
dual_webauthn_human_issuers: no RP, origin, enrollment, authenticator, assertion verifier or human issuer evidence exists

tie_rule: no automatic winner; a separate ADR must select the option with the smaller independently reviewed trust, parser, recovery and operational surface
